blocks.head: alt The user currently has permission at the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , User : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ User 'publishToggle' cloudB 
= < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , User : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ cloudB 'acknowledge' User .

eq < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , User : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ cloudB 'acknowledge' User 
= < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , User : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > .

eq < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : 'toggle' , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ User 'releaseMessage' cloudB 
= < User | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle') .

eq < deviceA | ('on' : false , ..) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle') 
= < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle') 
= < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .
